description: Digital temperature monitor with six Pt100 channels, two relays (alarm and protection) and an RS485 Modbus RTU port
source: GRAMEYER, GMT6-C Manual de Instalação e Operação, revision 03 of 29-10-2009 (MGBR08231)

sources.title: GMT6-C Manual de Instalação e Operação (MGBR08231)
sources.note: Table 2.1 (parameters and addresses), chapter 12 (communication) and tables 12.1 and 12.2; the PDF is attached to the map request

notes: Modbus RTU with functions 0x03 (read) and 0x06 (write). The addresses in the manual are hexadecimal and are the ones used in the frames (the example reads the first channel at 0x0040), so the map is 0-based.
Serial settings in the manual: 9600 bit/s, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit. The factory address given in the parameter table is 2.

The manual's parameter table lists addresses 0x40-0x45 as 'Faixa de temperatura Canal 1-6' (temperature range, factory value 200) among the write parameters, but the read example in chapter 12 reads the temperature of channel 1 at 0x0040, and 0x40-0x4D form one block together with the maximum values and the alarm and protection words. The map follows the example and reads them as the measured temperatures. Not tested on a device.

The factory values in the table for the gain (200) and offset (125) differ from the ones on the calibration screens (100 and 50); the units of gain and offset are not stated, so the map gives no scale for them.

The display shows '---' for a channel with no Pt100 connected or a temperature below 1 °C and 'erro' above 250 °C; the manual does not say what these cases read over Modbus. Switch off the alarm of unused channels.
